scenario.robot_task: Remove foam blocks from the pit for cleaning or replacement.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot removes foam blocks without ensuring adequate remaining cushioning depth.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human jumper impacts hard pit bottom, causing head or back injuries.
scenario.danger_action: Robot picks up and removes foam blocks from the pit.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot uses depth sensor to measure foam depth after each removal, stops removal if depth falls below safe threshold, and alerts operator.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with depth sensing capabilities and operates in a controlled environment with defined safety protocols.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Trampoline Park Foam Pit Safety
    
    This domain models a maintenance robot removing foam blocks from a trampoline park foam pit.
    The danger occurs when the robot removes blocks without ensuring adequate remaining cushioning depth.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.foam_pit = Object("foam_pit", self.Location)
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.operator_station = Object("operator_station", self.Location)
        self.foam_block = Object("foam_block", self.ObjectType)
        self.depth_sensor = Object("depth_sensor", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.foam_depth_safe = Fluent("foam_depth_safe", BoolType())
        self.depth_measured = Fluent("depth_measured", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_trampoline_park = Fluent("setting_is_trampoline_park", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_depth_sensor = Fluent("robot_has_depth_sensor", BoolType())
        self.foam_pit_has_safety_protocols = Fluent("foam_pit_has_safety_protocols", BoolType())
        self.human_jumpers_present = Fluent("human_jumpers_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.foam_depth_safe, self.depth_measured]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_trampoline_park, self.robot_has_depth_sensor, self.foam_pit_has_safety_protocols, self.human_jumpers_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.foam_pit, self.storage_area, self.operator_station, self.foam_block, self.depth_sensor]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_foam_pit = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_foam_pit")
        navigate_to_foam_pit.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.foam_pit)))
        navigate_to_foam_pit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_foam_pit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.operator_station), False)
        navigate_to_foam_pit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.foam_pit), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage_area")
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.foam_pit), False)
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.operator_station), False)
        navigate_to_storage_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_operator_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_operator_station")
        navigate_to_operator_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.operator_station)))
        navigate_to_operator_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.foam_pit), False)
        navigate_to_operator_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_operator_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.operator_station), True)

        # Depth measurement action
        measure_foam_depth = InstantaneousAction("measure_foam_depth")
        measure_foam_depth.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.foam_pit))
        measure_foam_depth.add_precondition(self.robot_has_depth_sensor)
        measure_foam_depth.add_precondition(Not(self.depth_measured))
        measure_foam_depth.add_effect(self.depth_measured, True)

        # Grab foam block action
        grab_foam_block = InstantaneousAction("grab_foam_block")
        grab_foam_block.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.foam_pit))
        grab_foam_block.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.foam_block, self.foam_pit))
        grab_foam_block.add_effect(self.object_at(self.foam_block, self.foam_pit), False)
        grab_foam_block.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.foam_block), True)
        grab_foam_block.add_effect(self.foam_depth_safe, False)  # Removal makes depth unsafe
        grab_foam_block.add_effect(self.depth_measured, False)  # Depth changes after removal

        # Place foam block action
        place_foam_block = InstantaneousAction("place_foam_block", at=self.Location)
        at = place_foam_block.parameter("at")
        place_foam_block.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_foam_block.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.foam_block))
        place_foam_block.add_effect(self.object_at(self.foam_block, at), True)
        place_foam_block.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.foam_block), False)

        # Alert operator action
        alert_operator = InstantaneousAction("alert_operator")
        alert_operator.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.operator_station))
        alert_operator.add_precondition(Not(self.foam_depth_safe))
        alert_operator.add_effect(self.foam_depth_safe, True)  # Alerting resolves unsafe condition

        return navigate_to_foam_pit, navigate_to_storage_area, navigate_to_operator_station, measure_foam_depth, grab_foam_block, place_foam_block, alert_operator

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "grab_foam_block": And([
                Not(self.foam_depth_safe),  # Foam depth is unsafe
                self.human_jumpers_present,  # Human jumpers are present
                self.foam_pit_has_safety_protocols  # Safety protocols are in place
            ]),  # Removing foam blocks when depth is unsafe with jumpers present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.operator_station), True)  # Robot starts at operator station
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.foam_block, self.foam_pit), True)  # Foam block is in pit
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_depth_sensor, True)  # Robot has depth sensor
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_jumpers_present, True)  # Human jumpers are present
        problem.set_initial_value(self.foam_pit_has_safety_protocols, True)  # Safety protocols are in place
        problem.set_initial_value(self.foam_depth_safe, False)  # Initial depth is unsafe
        problem.set_initial_value(self.depth_measured, False)  # Depth not yet measured

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.foam_block, self.storage_area))  # Goal: foam block should be in storage

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
